# Smart Nutrition

Smart Nutrition is an AI wellness companion for meal planning, food logging, barcode scanning, photo meal recognition, hydration tracking, reminders, progress analytics, Telegram assistant support, and family wellness context.

Canonical site: https://smart-nutrition.club/

Public entry points:

- Home: https://smart-nutrition.club/
- Create account: https://smart-nutrition.club/register
- Log in: https://smart-nutrition.club/login

Supported languages:

- Ukrainian
- Polish
- English

Important product principles:

- Smart Nutrition is one cloud-backed ecosystem, not a local-only calorie calculator.
- Backend/cloud state is the source of truth for meals, water, reminders, profile, AI actions, and family wellness context.
- The AI assistant must not claim it saved meals, reminders, water, profile changes, or family data unless the backend confirms the action.
- Wellness and pregnancy content is educational and should not be treated as medical diagnosis or treatment.

Private app areas such as dashboard, meals, profile, progress, reminders, partner invite, and verification/reset token routes should not be indexed.
